interpretation.advantages: Each candidate min-Q minus its own first actual candidate value; requested0 can be unreachable under completion floor
interpretation.requested_grid: Try proposal h then8h through unchangedF; unsupported requested durations retain actualF actions and are not counted as successful physical coverage
interpretation.holding: Analytic hurdle gate with128 fixed positive Gaussian CRNs; signed and absolute differences are both retained
interpretation.cancellation: 1-abs(mean signed)/mean absolute; zero when all differences are zero
interpretation.dependence: Repeated snapshots of3 fixed issues per scenario are descriptive, not independent held-out states
interpretation.scope: No counterfactual truth,300s regret,stable no-harm or passenger-cost improvement established

decision.next_gate: Inspect supported reward-credit contribution separately from Q level and terminal bootstrap; advance to independent physical validation only if common-action advantages and F holding show persistent material separation without isolated line or state failure.
